scripts.kill:ports: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const out = execSync('netstat -ano', { encoding: 'utf8' }); [3000, 3001, 3002, 3003, 3010, 3020].forEach(p => { out.split('\n').filter(l => l.includes(':' + p + ' ') && l.includes('LISTENING')).forEach(l => { const pid = l.trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); if (pid && pid !== '0') { try { process.kill(Number(pid)); console.log('Freed port', p, 'PID', pid); } catch(e){} } }); }); } catch(e){}"
